lead: Captured aviation intelligence highlights active customer acquisition and platform updates across major EFB, flight planning, and dispatch vendors, led by notable deployments for carriers such as Royal Air Maroc, fastjet, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Carrier Wins
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFB footprint by securing customer deployments and selections with fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), both classified as low-cost carriers, alongside hybrid/leisure operator TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) are low-cost carriers (LCCs), while TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure operator.
insights.caveat: Evidence is limited to captured press and LinkedIn announcements during the period.

insights.title: Aviobook Signs Five-Year Agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service network carrier.
insights.caveat: Terms outside the five-year duration and initial deployment scope were not disclosed.

insights.title: Jeppesen Introduces AI and Mobile Hardware Support
insights.finding: Jeppesen launched Airflow to integrate AI into flight operations and updated ForeFlight to provide support for the Apple iPhone Duo.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight is widely utilized across commercial and business aviation segments.
insights.caveat: Adoption metrics and operational performance outcomes for Airflow are unstated.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Business Unit Sale
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems reportedly explored a potential sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine comprise core flight planning, navigation, and crew management product lines.
insights.caveat: Financial Times reporting reflects market exploration rather than a completed transaction.

insights.title: Navblue Expands Skywise Integration with TransNusa
insights.finding: Navblue expanded its collaboration with TransNusa to integrate flight and technical operations using Skywise Core X2 and S.FP+.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and low-cost passenger services in Southeast Asia.
insights.caveat: Captured text marks the first agreement for these specific products in Indonesia.
